synthesis: Scout invite lockout has three parts: (1) resend already exists (resend_onboarding from the earlier hotfix) for email_verified_at=null users but does not revoke prior signed URLs; (2) soft-deleted users keep email under a full unique index — Filament unique checks miss trashed rows (SoftDeletes scope) so create can pass form validation then fail at DB, matching Ryan's 'already in there'; (3) disable via toggle_web_access already re-enables permission, but soft-deleted users have no Scout Users restore path (canDelete=false; Restore lives on UsersResource). Password reset remains a sibling ticket.

questions.q: When a soft-deleted Scout user's email is reused on create: (A) detect collision and offer Restore / Resend / Re-enable (no DB unique change), or (B) migrate to a partial unique index so deleted emails are free for a brand-new user?
questions.answer: A: Detect soft-deleted collision and offer Restore / Resend / Re-enable; no DB unique change

questions.q: On Resend invite: (A) hard-invalidate prior links via a per-user nonce bump in the signed URL, or (B) keep today's behavior (new link + old link valid until 7-day expiry or first successful set-password)?
questions.answer: A: Hard-invalidate prior onboarding links via per-user nonce bump on resend

questions.q: AC4 'disabled user': (A) only the existing Scout Access toggle (already works), or (B) also add Restore for soft-deleted users on Scout Users?
questions.answer: B: Also add Restore for soft-deleted users on Scout Users (toggle_web_access remains for permission disable)
